text_block_list.text:
...I've finally gotten my hands on it. 
With this, I can...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: You look like you're having a lot of fun.
You look like you're having a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's rare to see Narita Taishin looking 
visibly cheerful even to onlookers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On her table were jellies, juices, and 
snack cakes, all boasting to be "Small 
Portions, Rich in Nutrients!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What are you staring at? It's just 
regular nutritional food, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I thought it'd help with growth.

Yeah, I thought it'd be helpful for 
growth.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Do you think so too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Just you watch, I'm gonna grow big 
in no time...!
choice_data_list: Be careful not to eat too much.
Alright! Let's get some hearty nutrition!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like I need you to tell me that!
choice_data_list:
Still, Taishin tends to push herself too 
hard sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Right, right. ...But don't you worry~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo-chan, Hayahide-chan, and I are 
all watching closely, so~

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Creek-san, when did you—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like I said, none of your business!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Even if you say that, it's just in 
my nature to look after others~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, it looks like we can prevent 
Narita Taishin from pushing herself too 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching their exchange unfold, I let out 
a sigh of relief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought taking this in moderation 
alongside meals might stimulate bodily 
growth, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Damn it, this can't be happening!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
After working that hard, how is it that I 
only gained width?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-chan... didn't I tell you not to 
overdo it with all those nutritional 
supplements?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I tell them to 
stop, they just sneak in and take them 
anyway~

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up! I just thought it'd make me 
grow bigger faster, so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...And here I thought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin hung her head in dejection. 
The road to reshaping her physique still 
appeared steep and arduous.
